text.en: Increase in the MAV for Pork. The MAV of pork meat for MAV Year 2026 is increased from

Allocation of MAV to Importers. The MMC is hereby directed to ensure that the allocation of
the volume importation is fair and is in accordance with the following: 30,000 MT for processors, and
120,000 MT for the Food Terminal Inc. or the KADIWA ng Pangulo Program.

Guidelines. The MMC is hereby directed to formulate and issue the implementation guidelines,
within thirty (30) days from the effectivity of this Order. The guidelines shall ensure that the allocations
intended for the Food Terminal Inc. and the KADIWA ng Pangulo Program are efficiently utilized and
implemented in a manner consistent with the objectives of the MAV Plus mechanism particularly in
augmenting domestic supply, stabilizing market prices, and promoting consumer welfare.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon its publication in the Official Gazette

or a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 19th day of May in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Six.
(Sgd.) FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR.
By the President:
(Sgd.) RALPH G. RECTO
Acting Executive Secretary
